recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban illustration featuring a central mechanical figure integrated with turntable components, set against a dark red background filled with tonal graffiti tags. The style blends sharp, angular mecha-anime aesthetics with wildstyle graffiti lettering and a metallic color palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Mechanical limbs interlocking with turntable platters and tonearms
Aggressive graffiti typography framing the top of the central subject
Tonal background patterns providing texture without distracting from the foreground
Gold and chrome highlights contrasting against deep red and black shadows
coreInvariants: Heavy black outlines on all foreground elements
Metallic gradients (gold and silver) for primary objects
Angular, sharp-edged geometry in both character and type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, large-scale mechanical entity occupying 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular turntable platter in the center of the mechanical mass.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the platter, leading upward to the stylized title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is densely packed with low-contrast graffiti motifs.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep maroon/red background with tonal variations.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black for heavy outlines and deep shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic gold and chrome silver for highlights and focal points.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between metallic highlights and dark background; low saturation in the background patterns.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy horizontal emphasis with compressed verticality
Thick black outlines with internal gold gradients
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters integrated with star shapes or mechanical notches
Quotation marks rendered as sharp, blade-like strokes

composition.overlap: Letters overlap each other and the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive custom display type paired with a clean, sans-serif block for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive urban aesthetic of the original lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an urban illustration of a mechanical entity made of turntable parts, tonearms, and wires. Use a color palette of gold, chrome, and black. Set against a dark maroon background with faint, tonal graffiti tags.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom wildstyle graffiti lettering at the top with a gold gradient fill and thick black outlines. Add a small block of sans-serif text at the bottom inside a horizontal bar.

verificationChecks: Are the outlines thick and black?
Is the background a deep red with tonal patterns?
Do the mechanical parts include turntable platters?
Is the typography sharp and angular?

postGenerationChecks: Check for sharp, clean vector edges
Ensure the gold gradient is vibrant
Verify the mechanical parts look functional yet abstract
Confirm the background doesn't overpower the foreground
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Mecha-Graffiti Style: [Subject] + [Mechanical Integration] + [Wildstyle Typography] + [Maroon/Gold/Chrome Palette]
